Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
A 'let's see how big it gets' quiz:

Your four opponents have neither played any cards nor controlled any
minions at any point. They will not use any cards, nor will they play
to help you in any way. If some effect would give them a vote, they
will all cast as many as they safely can against you.

The edge is currently uncontrolled, and all players can be assumed to
have 30 pool.

You have four minions in play, the only ones you have controlled so
far. You have no vampires in your ash heap.

You may have any library cards and/or effects in play or affecting
your minions that you can justify having (given these conditions),
with one exception: nobody's deck was built with any Master:
Discipline cards, or the Soul Gem. You can even dictate the order of
the cards remaining in your library (started at 90 cards) and crypt
(started with 12 cards).

It's the start of your turn. How many votes in favor can you generate
for the referendum of your choice this turn? (You can call multiple
votes this turn if you like. The challenge is to get the most positive
votes on any single referendum.)

-John Flournoy
